name: simple command with options and args
sequential commands with semicolon and newline
and/or list chaining
source: test -f config.json && cat config.json || echo 'default' > config.json

name: redirects combining stdin, stdout, and stderr
standard if-then-elif-else-fi clause
source:
if [ -d "$DIR" ]; then
  echo "directory exists"
elif [ -f "$DIR" ]; then
  echo "it is a file"
else
  echo "not found"
fi

name: for-in loop over quoted list
source:
for item in 'first item' 'second item' 'third'; do
  echo "processing $item"
done

name: while loop with test condition and break
source:
while read -r line; do
  [ -z "$line" ] && break
  echo "> $line"
done < input.txt

name: until loop with multiple commands in condition
source:
until ping -c 1 host.local >/dev/null 2>&1; do
  sleep 1
done

name: case statement with multiple pattern alternatives and wildcards
subshell execution with environment variable assignment
POSIX function definition with comments inside
